thread:
erica: heads-up: i've been combing the starter-kit quickstart and there are ~4 different auth snippets floating around. proposing a tiny cleanup sprint to pick one minimal example, fix links, and land a short migration note for sdk v6->v7.

kate: +1. can we standardize on the smallest Node + curl combo? keeps the quickstart lean for new devs. :thumbsup:

sam: fine by me. are we also changing the repo examples? iirc one example still uses process.env.REDWOOD_API which we deprecated.

erica: yes, we'll update repo examples too. plan: 1) pick canonical snippet 2) swap snippets in docs and repo 3) fix broken links in the quickstart (auth and deploy sections) 4) add a short migration blurb. i'll open a meta PR to coordinate.

naveen: if we're standardizing, i'd push for explicit fetch example that shows streaming minimal setup. something like:
```
// minimal fetch example
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello world' })
});
const data = await res.json();
console.log(data.output);
```

kate: that looks good. can we also include the one-line curl so folks can try without code? e.g. `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'`

alex_platform: please add a note about the new env var name and link the dedicated auth page. broken link spotted: /docs/auth -> 404 in quickstart. i'll patch the link if someone points me to the canonical target.

erica: thanks. i'll create the meta PR now and list the sub-PRs as checklist items. assigning owners: kate -> canonical snippet + curl, naveen -> streaming/fetch example, sam -> repo example swaps, alex_platform -> link fixes + migration blurb.

sam: good. quick ask: can the meta PR include a smoke CI job to validate code blocks compile? we had one bad JS with backticks last time that broke copy-paste. :grimacing:

ci-bot: note: we can add a lightweight docs-only GH action -> runs `node examples/quickstart/check.js` if present. i can add an example check.js that loads each snippet and verifies syntax.

kate: i'll add a tiny check.js that uses vm.runInNewContext to parse examples. will include in my PR.

naveen: timeline? i'd like to get this in before the onboarding session next Wed.

erica: target = EOD tues (1739080000) for meta PR open, sub-PRs by Wed morning. if anyone can't make that ping me and we'll reassign.

alex_platform: noted. will look at the /docs/auth redirect tonight.

erica: i'll post the meta PR link here when it's up and tag owners. thanks y'all! :sparkles:
